description: VirusTotal for attachments, with the user's own API key: look a file up by its SHA-256 (the file isn't sent), or upload one the user chose and follow its analysis.

functions.name: lookup
functions.description: What VirusTotal knows about a file, by its SHA-256. Returns { status (HTTP), stats, flagged (engine → name, malicious only), error }. 404: VirusTotal hasn't seen it.

functions.name: upload
functions.description: Upload a file for VirusTotal to scan (only when the user asked: VirusTotal shares uploaded files). Returns { status, analysis (id), error }.

functions.name: analysis
functions.description: An upload's analysis. Returns { status, state (queued, in-progress, completed), stats, flagged, sha256, error }.
